title: Library mode for sidecar export; sync and git ignore sidecars
description:
## Intent
Library mode and keeping sidecars out of sync and git.

## Scope
- `--library DIR`: resolve each path through the library (`samplesByPath`, aliases) as `apricity_data::loader::make` does; write beside `files/audio/<sampleId>/<file>`.
- `crates/apricity-data/src/sync.rs`: `*.asd` and `*.alc` under `files/` are machine-local (never uploaded, downloaded, listed or deleted), next to the existing `.DS_Store` rule; the new `features/sync/sync.feature` scenario green.
- `.gitignore`: `/samples/**/*.asd`, `/samples/**/*.alc`.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-data sync` and `safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` (library scenarios green); `scripts/sync-smoke.sh` still passes.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): sidecars in a library, excluded from sync`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
